title: Meteorite Crater
description: A jagged crater still radiates heat from a recent stellar impact. Wisps of iridescent smoke curl upward from the scorched basin, and the air hums with residual cosmic energy. Glittering dust and embedded fragments of otherworldly metal line the crater walls.

choices.label: Collect the starfall dust
choices.description: The iridescent dust coating the crater is a valuable reagent.

outcomes.text: You scoop handfuls of shimmering dust from the crater basin. It hums faintly in your pouch.
The dust is thicker than expected — entire drifts of it have settled in the crevices. A generous haul.
A burst of residual cosmic energy flares as you reach in. The flash sears your eyes, leaving spots dancing across your vision.

choices.label: Harvest meteorite fragments
choices.description: Pry loose the crystallized fragments embedded in the crater wall.

outcomes.text: You wrench a chunk of astral metal free from the scorched rock. It gleams with an inner light.
The fragment comes loose easily, and behind it you find a vein of crystal chitin fused into the wall.
The crater wall collapses inward as you pry. Superheated debris rains down, shocking you with a jolt of cosmic static.

choices.label: Leave the crater
choices.description: The cosmic radiation feels unsafe. Better to move on.

outcomes.text: You back away from the pulsing heat. Some treasures aren't worth the risk.
